purpose: Ingest and capacity-screen one defined Northbound Stock Connect top-turnover net-buy mechanism before observing any interface row or historical factor return.

rejected_alternative.reason: The official page states that exchanges stopped daily Northbound holding publication from 2024-08-20 and changed to quarterly disclosure, so it cannot support a current three-session signal.

mechanism_identity.economic_mechanism: Net Northbound buy amount among each Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Connect market's ten highest-turnover securities, normalized by that security's disclosed buy plus sell amount.
mechanism_identity.relationship_to_tushare_moneyflow: Independent participant-and-event mechanism: hsgt_top10 is a sparse Northbound Stock Connect top-turnover disclosure, while moneyflow classifies all-market transactions by order size without identifying Northbound participation.
mechanism_identity.relationship_to_billboard: Independent disclosure population: Stock Connect top turnover is not the exchange abnormal-trading billboard and does not use billboard reasons, seats, or post-return fields.

source.request_mode: one completed local trading session and one fixed market_type per call

point_in_time_policy.source_time_field: trade_date normalized to the local A-share trading session
point_in_time_policy.signal_assignment: signal-session close for a following-local-session-open entry
point_in_time_policy.residual_risk: A provider delay beyond 20:00 can make a row unavailable for the next open; every immutable snapshot retains its retrieval timestamp.

factor.name: tushare_northbound_top10_net_buy_share
factor.absent_security_policy: missing; never treat a security outside that market's disclosed top ten as zero
factor.zero_denominator_policy: exclude the observed security-day and keep the factor missing
factor.negative_or_missing_raw_policy: exclude and count incomplete rows; any negative amount, buy, or sell value aborts the partition
factor.amount_reconciliation: abs(amount - (buy + sell)) <= max(1 CNY, 0.000001 * max(amount, buy + sell))
factor.rank_policy: rank must be an integer from 1 through 10 within each trade_date and market_type

snapshot_contract.universe_membership: retain only instruments inside their point-in-time holding interval on trade_date; STAR, BSE, funds, bonds, and absent names are excluded and counted

partition_policy.provider_call_partition: one local trading session and one market_type

required_checks_before_large_sync: the environment supplies TUSHARE_TOKEN without logging its value
both fixed market requests return without an entitlement error
the response contains exactly the requested field whitelist
returned keys are unique and inside the fixed completed session
market_type equals the requested market and ranks are unique integers from 1 through 10
amount, buy, and sell are numeric and nonnegative
amount reconciles to buy plus sell under the frozen tolerance
the locally recomputed positive-denominator factor lies in [-1, 1]
no credential, price, provider net amount, or return appears in the snapshot or manifest
acceptance_protocol.failed_acceptance_policy: write a no-return entitlement/schema rejection record and stop without a large sync, capacity audit, price access, substitute formula, or purchase recommendation

source_completeness_policy.empty_market_session_allowed: yes, because Stock Connect can be closed on a local A-share session; record every empty request explicitly
source_completeness_policy.failed_gate_policy: stop before factor capacity or returns; do not fill closed sessions, widen dates, mix a second provider, or use hk_hold after its daily discontinuation

coverage_and_capacity_policy.failed_gate_policy: stop without reading returns, changing direction, adding transaction rank or amount as a second factor, lowering cohort size, widening event age, or combining an old rejected factor
